official.deadline_central_display: January 15, 2027 (Common Application and AU EGLS application/essays)
official.deadline_note: Both Step 1 (Common Application with supporting documents) and Step 2 (AU EGLS application and essays via the applicant portal) are due January 15, 2027; late applications will not be considered. Finalists and award winners are notified by April 1, 2027.
official.status_note: American University recommends that AU EGLS applicants apply Regular Decision for Fall 2027; some early applicants may be deferred for further consideration for the award.
official.tuition_coverage_note: The AU EGLS covers all billable AU expenses (full tuition, room, and board).
official.funding_period: per year, renewable for up to four years
benefits: Covers all billable AU expenses (full tuition, room, and board)

Students interested in all majors offered at AU are eligible to apply

eligibility: International student who will need a non-immigrant visa (preferably an F-1 or J-1 student visa) to study in the United States
Demonstrated commitment to leadership, volunteerism, community service, and advancing the needs of people in the home country
Still enrolled in secondary/high school and graduating by June 2027
Meets American University's English proficiency requirements
requirements: Step 1: submit the Common Application and all supporting documents before January 15, 2027
Step 2: submit the AU EGLS application and essays via the applicant portal by the January 15, 2027 deadline (Step 1 must be completed first)
Submit official English proficiency scores sent directly by the testing agency; self-reported results are not accepted
Submit a bank letter and the AU Declaration of Finances Form confirming a minimum of US $4,000
Complete Zoom interviews and/or additional essay submissions if selected as a semi-finalist or finalist

applicant_utility.summary: This is one of the most selective international undergraduate awards in the U.S. - two full scholarships per year - and it requires two submissions that share one hard deadline: the Common Application and the AU EGLS application with essays, both due January 15, 2027. Apply under Regular Decision as AU recommends, and budget roughly US $4,000 a year for non-billable costs the award does not cover. If you miss the full award, strong EGLS applicants are still considered for partial scholarships of up to US $40,000 per year, so a serious attempt pays off either way.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International students needing an F-1/J-1 visa who combine strong academics with a documented record of leadership, volunteering, and community service in their home country.
application_readiness_checklist: Complete the Common Application and all supporting documents first - Step 2 only becomes available after Step 1 is done
Draft the EGLS essays around concrete civic contributions and change you drove in your home community
Book TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo early and have scores sent directly by the testing agency
Arrange a bank letter and the AU Declaration of Finances Form showing at least US $4,000
Keep interview windows free - semi-finalists and finalists face Zoom interviews and additional essays
common_rejection_risks: Submitting Step 2 late or assuming a late file will be reviewed - late applications are not considered at all
Self-reported English scores instead of official agency-sent results
Essays that read as generic leadership statements without evidence of home-country impact
Applying Early Decision/Early Action and being deferred, which weakens EGLS consideration
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Approximately US $4,000 per year for non-billable expenses: mandatory health insurance, books, airline tickets, and miscellaneous costs. AU's published first-year figure for study and living expenses is US $87,374.
document_audit: The bank letter and AU Declaration of Finances Form must be filed through the applicant portal, not emailed
English test scores must come directly from the testing agency - self-reported scores leave the file deficient
Standard admission documents must be complete before January 15, not after
alerts: Both steps share one hard deadline of January 15, 2027 - finish the Common App in early January at the latest
Regular Decision is the recommended plan; early applicants may be deferred for award consideration
Partial-scholarship finalists must show additional funds beyond the initial US $4,000 for the uncovered balance
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Common Application (Step 1) -> EGLS application and essays in the portal (Step 2) -> semi-finalist/finalist Zoom interviews and essays -> finalists and winners notified by April 1, 2027.
